workarounds.symptom: Managed jobs convert any_of resources to ordered, changing backend selection
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Jobs] Preserve any_of semantics when adding Kubernetes annotations. Target files: sky/jobs/controller.py, tests/unit_tests/test_sky/jobs/test_controller.py. Managed-job controller's `_add_k8s_annotations()` rebuilt every resource collection as a list. SkyPilot represents `any_of` resources as a set and `ordered` resources as a list, so this changed `any_of` into `ordered` immediately before launch. Optimizer then selected first launchable resource in set-iteration order instead of comparing all candidates by cost. (Ref: https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10490)

workarounds.symptom: [API_SERVER]`/validate` ignores the user's workspace and fails with "Workspace 'default' not found"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [API Server] Resolve the active workspace for /validate. Target files: sky/server/requests/executor.py, sky/server/server.py, sky/skypilot_config.py. `POST /validate` runs inline in the API server, so it never went through `executor.override_request_env_and_config`. Without a client-set `active_workspace` it always ran in the literal `default`, unlike `/optimize` and `/launch`, which resolve it from the user's preferred workspace or memberships.
